segment.description: Daddy's Creek (Cumberland County), gorge water in the Obed system, running its full named length to the Obed confluence near Hebbertsburg; lower reach inside Obed Wild & Scenic River.
segment.boundaries: Headwaters in Cumberland County (USGS 03539600 near Hebbertsburg at 35.9977, -84.8225) downstream to the confluence with the Obed River; TDEC scenic-river designation covers Daddy's Creek from the Morgan County line to its Obed confluence.

coldSource.notes: No dam tailwater: TDEC's Obed scenic-river designation includes Daddy's Creek from the Morgan County line to its Obed confluence as part of the free-flowing Wild & Scenic system. Elevation is the USGS 03539600 gauge near Hebbertsburg (1444.69 ft). NRCA: Daddy's Creek 1982-1998 temperatures ranged 0.3-28.4 C with the highest in July and September (mean 14.1 C).

holdover.detail: No trout fishery documented on this water (see wildPopulation), so holdover evidence was not sought or found.

wildPopulation.detail: NPS fish-assemblage inventories document zero trout: Russ (2006) sampled two Daddy's Creek locations inside Obed WSR (19 species, whitetail/telescope shiners, rock bass, smallmouth) and Scott (2010b) found 13 species; the park's certified 55-species fish list (Appendix G) contains no Salmonidae, and a text search of the full NRCA report returns zero 'trout' hits. Daddy's Creek is also absent from TWRA's 2026 trout stocking schedule and wild-trout-stream list.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: NPS surveys at two Daddy's Creek park locations recorded zero salmonids and the Hebbertsburg gauge reached 30.0 C on 2026-07-02.
